title: Software Engineer Sênior
description:

Um ambiente de trabalho saudável é um lugar onde todas as vozes são ouvidas, respeitadas e valorizadas. Você atuará em colaboração com equipes de Data Engineering, Data Science e Consultoria Analítica, garantindo que as soluções sejam escaláveis, seguras e integradas às necessidades reais dos nossos clientes. Além de desenvolver, você será referência técnica, ajudando a definir padrões e boas práticas dentro da equipe. Suas principais responsabilidades incluirão: Liderar o desenvolvimento de aplicações webutilizandoJavaScript/TypeScripte frameworks modernos comoReact e Next.Js, priorizando arquitetura limpa, reuso e performance. Projetar e implementar soluções de integração de dadoscom bancos relacionais e não relacionais(PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Azure Cosmos DB), com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade. Gerenciar e otimizar aplicações na nuvem, configurando autenticação, segurança e deploys contínuos em múltiplos provedores cloud, comoAzure, GCP e AWS. Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinar :transformando modelos e algoritmos de dados em soluções visuais e produtos interativos. Definir arquitetura de softwaree padrões técnicos, promovendo boas práticas deDevOps, CI/CD, testes automatizados e versionamento (Git, Docker, Kubernetes). Mentorar desenvolvedoresde diferentes níveis, promovendo crescimento técnico e colaboração. Contribuir estrategicamentepara decisões de produto, explorando novas tecnologias e garantindo qualidade e sustentabilidade das soluções.O que nós estamos procurando;
Formação:Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou curso na área correlata. Experiência solida (+5 anos):em desenvolvimento web comReact, Next.Js, JavaScript e TypeScript. Domínio em bancos de dados SQL e NoSQL, com habilidade em modelagem, otimização de queries e performance. Vivência avançada em nuvem (Azure, AWS ou GCP), incluindo autenticação, pipelines, integração de serviços e observabilidade. Experiência prática com DevOps e CI/CD, uso deDocker ,Kubernetese ferramentas de integração contínua. Visão arquiteturale capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas estratégicas. Inglês fluente(para interação com equipes e clientes internacionais).O que oferecemos;
VR/VT Free office(trabalhe de casa ou de onde quiser!) Gympass Seguros:Vida, saúde e odontológico Encontros Bimestrais(Famoso "Get Together" onde nos encontramos para estarmos juntos, com oficinas, palestras, treinamentos e aquele happy hour!) Woba(pode marcar para trabalhar em coworking onde quiser!) Avaliações semestrais(com oportunidade de promoção)Por que você deveria se juntar a nós;
Artefacté o lugar para estar: venha e construa o futuro da tecnologia de dados Progresso:cada dia oferece novos desafios e novas oportunidades de aprender Cultura:junte-se à melhor equipe que você poderia imaginar Empreendedorismo:você se juntará a uma equipe de empreendedores motivados. Não desistiremos até que façamos uma grande diferença nesta indústria! Junte-se a nós!

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description: In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working fromBrazil remotelyto join our team and provide high‐level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.How You'll Help Us Connect the World:You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue. You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.Required Qualifications for Consideration:8+ years of experience working in the networking space 5+ years of experience working in a TAC Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS Expertise of wireless deployments – AP's, Controllers, Client associations, etc Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark High level of English. Available Monday through Friday or 'staggered work week's, i.E. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.Why Join Us? Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next.....Come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

title: Principal Technical Support Engineer (Remote)
description: In our 'always on' world, we believe it's essential to have a genuine connection with the work you do.We are excited to announce that we are hiring a Principal Technical Support Engineer in working fromBrazil remotelyto join our team and provide high‐level technical expertise to our Ruckus Premium (BullDog) customers.Your primary responsibility is to serve as a key technical resource, delivering expert assistance and ensuring prompt resolution of complex customer issues.How You'll Help Us Connect the World:You work directly with customers to troubleshoot problems, isolate root causes, and drive cases to closure with a high level of technical accuracy and professionalism. When needed, you reproduce customer scenarios in the Support Lab to validate findings and deepen understanding of the issue. You collaborate closely with Engineering teams to manage escalations, resolve product bugs, and ensure that long-term corrective actions are identified and implemented. Throughout each case, you provide consistent updates to sales teams, internal management, and customers, maintaining clear communication and transparency at every stage.Given the nature of the role, you are expected to support a staggered work week when required (such as Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday) and participate in a rotating on-call schedule. Flexibility in work hours is essential to accommodate urgent customer needs. You thoroughly document customer interactions, engineering engagements, and action plans to ensure high-quality case management and knowledge continuity.Beyond case handling, you contribute to the organization by creating and refining knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, and internal training materials. You provide mentoring and coaching to team members to help strengthen overall team capability. You also participate regularly in customer and internal conference calls for high-profile cases and escalations, ensuring issues receive appropriate visibility. All responsibilities are carried out with strict adherence to Service Level Agreement KPIs.Required Qualifications for Consideration:8+ years of experience working in the networking space 5+ years of experience working in a TAC Excellent written and oral communication ability, including formal presentation skills to customers, partners, Ruckus accounts and support teams Excellent understanding and applied knowledge of TCP/IP, L3 routing, L2 switching, Multicast, firewalls, QOS Solid understanding and troubleshooting skills with wireless technologies 802.11x, WLAN authentication, encryption, EAP, PSK, Radius, AAA, DNS Expertise of wireless deployments – AP's, Controllers, Client associations, etc Excellent understanding of RF transmission and antenna behavior Technical expertise in troubleshooting and resolving complex Layer 2/3 and/or wireless issues in multi-vendor environments Experience providing support to direct customers, resellers, and field personnel in resolving company product related issues Ability to provide technical guidance to other members in the team Experience working in a support lab environment for problem replication Experience documenting the sequence of events related to resolving customer technical issues Proficient with analyzing data traces from protocol analyzers such as Wireshark High level of English. Available Monday through Friday or 'staggered work week's, i.E. Sunday through Thursday or Tuesday through Saturday and weekend or overnight hours as required.Why Join Us? Vistance Networks shapes the future of communications technology, pushing past what is possible. We deliver solutions that bring reliability and performance to a world always in motion. Our global team of innovators and employees are trusted advisors who listen to customers first, then deliver value.RUCKUS Networks delivers purpose-driven enterprise networks that enable superior business outcomes in demanding environments. Our solutions combine AI-powered automation, proactive network assurance, and context-aware security, providing exceptional performance with simplified management.If you want to grow your career alongside bright, passionate, and caring people who strive to create what's next.....Come connect to your future at Vistance Networks.Vistance Networks is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EEO), including people with disabilities and veterans.

If you're excited about shaping intelligent, personalized digital experiences and pushing the boundaries of what modern e-commerce can become, we'd love to connect.

Comfortable reading and interpreting light code (e.G., JSON, HTML, basic scripting) to diagnose issues, troubleshoot integrations, and collaborate effectively with engineering teams. Problem-solving Ability: An analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues quickly. Capable of working under pressure and handling multiple tasks simultaneously. Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, able to explain technical issues to non-technical users. Strong customer service skills with a focus on user satisfaction. Comfort reviewing technical documentation or light code to support troubleshooting and collaboration with engineering teams. Previous work with an American company Education & Certifications:Formal education in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related technical discipline is preferred but not required. Continuous learning mindset, with interest in understanding APIs, integrations, and modern SaaS platforms.Who You Are: A solid technical aptitude - we love tech support backgrounds or a history of self-started technical growth. Ex: Java (Spring Boot, Quarkus), .NET, Node.Js, Python, PHP, etc ● Proatividade para identificar gargalos e conduzir melhorias de impacto ● Perfil colaborativo e orientado a influenciar engenharia com profundidade técnica ● Capacidade de atuar sob pressão em ambientes de missão crítica (core de investimentos) ● Fome por evolução tecnológica, dados, automação e inovação contínuaDIFERENCIAL: ● Conhecimento do mercado financeiro de investimentos.O QUE OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ: ️ Vale Refeição/Vale Alimentação (flexível) Assistência Médica Assistência Odontológica Einstein Conecta: Orientação médica online com os especialistas do Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein, totalmente gratuito. ️Seguro de Vida: Segurança para você e quem você ama. Auxílio Creche: Para ajudar nas despesas dos pequenos Licença Maternidade e Paternidade Estendida: Mais tempo para aproveitar os momentos especiais. Previdência Privada: Planeje o futuro com segurança. Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR): Sucesso compartilhado com todos. Fretado das estações Barra Funda e Santana Gympass: Acesso a academias e atividades físicas para manter a saúde em dia. ️ Parceria com o SESC: Acesso a lazer e cultura com benefícios exclusivos Reset Day: 1 dia OFF por ano para aproveitar da melhor forma.Por que escolher a Dimensa? Na Dimensa, você fará parte de um time que está revolucionando o mercado de operações financeiras, crédito e risco, e seguros, com inovação e tecnologia de ponta. Queremos conhecer você e ver como você pode contribuir para nossa missão!Junte-se a nós e faça a diferença.#VEMFAZERPARTEDAONDAVERDE

title: Manager, Corporate Development - M&A Origination & Deal Sourcing
description: Gemini Group (csigemini.Com) is part of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), a global acquirer, builder, and manager of vertical market software businesses. Gemini partners with high-quality software companies, providing long-term operational support, capital, and strategic guidance to help them grow sustainably. Our portfolio spans multiple vertical markets and operates through decentralized business units that are deeply embedded in their respective industries. Learn more here: csigemini.ComThe Role The Manager, Corporate Development will play a critical role in identifying, building, and nurturing strategic relationships that lead to new acquisition opportunities for Gemini Group.In this role, you will engage with software company leaders. Your success will be measured by your ability to cultivate meaningful, trust-based relationships that ultimately result in Gemini acquiring high-quality software businesses. Relationship-building in this role is a long-term endeavor - often taking multiple years from first contact to acquisition. Success requires persistence, strategic thinking, disciplined pipeline management, high-quality market research, and a consistent ability to add value across many conversations.As Gemini continues to expand its presence globally, this Brazil based role will also play a foundational part in helping scale Gemini's M&A capability in the LATAM market. Over time, the Manager, Corporate Development will have the opportunity to contribute to the growth of a localized M&A function - including shaping best practices and helping establish Gemini as a preferred partner for LATAM software entrepreneurs. This is a unique chance to be a builder of Gemini's deal-sourcing footprint in Brazil while advancing your own leadership trajectory within the organization.Key Outcomes Develop, manage, and expand an M&A pipeline using Salesforce CRM, including market mapping within assigned software verticals. Meet and exceed weekly and quarterly sourcing and relationship-building KPIs. Work both independently and in collaboration with Gemini's M&A leadership to efficiently evaluate potential acquisition opportunities. Ensure accurate categorization and allocation of leads within relevant portfolio verticals. Effectively screen and qualify opportunities at the top of the acquisition funnel to support Portfolio Managers and operating teams. Support the long-term build-out of Gemini's LATAM/Brazil M&A presence by contributing to sourcing processes, knowledge sharing, and future team development. Engage directly with founders, CEOs, and controlling shareholders, conducting high-quality M&A conversations to understand ownership dynamics, M&A insights, motivations, business insights and timing of a future, potential deal. Qualify opportunities through initial commercial, operational, and financial assessment, filtering deals before internal escalation. Coordinate internally with global teams (Perseus / CSI) to align on pipeline prioritization and strategic fit. Maintain structured tracking of interactions and insights (CRM-driven), ensuring continuity and depth of relationship over time.Relevant Experience & Competencies At least three years of experience in M&A business development, with proven involvement in various aspects of M&A such as mandate origination (including private equity), initial contact with key decision-makers, deal negotiation, or client-facing roles in M&A or finance within the software or technology sector. Experience in outbound deal origination planning. Previous exposure on relationship-building meetings (virtual or in-person) with company owners to explore strategic M&A opportunities. Demonstrated interest in building a long-term career in software investing, M&A, or corporate development. Track record of high performance in business development, entrepreneurship, or other competitive environments. Strong executive presence with the ability to confidently engage senior leaders, including CEOs, investors, and advisors. Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable working autonomously. Self-motivated, proactive, and results-driven with a strong sense of urgency.Other Requirements Willingness to travel occasionally within Brazil and broader LATAM as well as internationally to Canada, the U.S., and Portugal. Professional working proficiency in both English and Portuguese is required. Professional working proficiency in Spanish is a bonus.

title: Tech Lead - Java
description:

Etapas do Processo:Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra. Meios de Comunicação:Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.O que buscamos?Estamos em busca de um/uma Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe de desenvolvimento. Quem ocupar essa posição desempenhará um papel crucial na liderança técnica, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor por meio da otimização do fluxo de valor (Value Stream) e da implementação de soluções de alta qualidade que estejam alinhadas aos objetivos de negócios dos nossos clientes.Como será seu dia-a-dia?Liderança técnica:Fornece liderança e orientação técnica à equipe de desenvolvimento, estabelecendo padrões de qualidade, aderindo às melhores práticas e garantindo a implementação de soluções técnicas eficientes e escaláveis;
Compreensão do fluxo devalor:Trabalha com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender o fluxo de valor completo, desde a concepção da ideia até a entrega do produto, identificando áreas de melhoria e reduzindo desperdícios no processo;
Colaboração com equipesmultifuncionais:Trabalha em estreita colaboração com gerentes de produto, analistas de negócios, arquitetos e desenvolvedores para entender as necessidades dos negócios, traduzi-las em requisitos técnicos e garantir que as soluções propostas estejam alinhadas com os objetivos gerais do projeto e do cliente;
Gerenciamento de projetos e entregas:Monitora o progresso dos projetos, identifique gargalos e proponha soluções para garantir que os prazos e os padrões de qualidade sejam cumpridos. Além disso, coordene a implementação de práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega;
Planejamento e design técnico:Lidera o planejamento e o design técnico de projetos de integração e API, garantindo a aplicação de melhores práticas, reutilização e escalabilidade. Isto inclui a definição da arquitetura do sistema, a seleção de tecnologias e ferramentas e a identificação de riscos e oportunidades de melhoria;
Entrega contínua de valor:Monitora e otimize o fluxo de trabalho da equipe, garantindo a entrega contínua de valor para os clientes e partes interessadas, coordenando práticas de CI/CD e automação para otimizar o processo de desenvolvimento e entrega;
Desenvolvimento e revisão de código : Desenvolve acompanha o desenvolvimento de integrações e APIs, fornecendo orientações técnicas e conduzindo revisões de código para garantir a qualidade e a aderência às normas e práticas recomendadas;
Mentoria e desenvolvimento da equipe:Promove o crescimento e o desenvolvimento da equipe de desenvolvimento por meio de mentoria, compartilhamento de conhecimento e promoção de um ambiente de aprendizado contínuo. Isso inclui a realização de sessões de treinamento, fornecendo feedback construtivo e apoiando a resolução de problemas complexos;
Medição e melhoria de resultados:Utiliza métricas e indicadores relevantes para avaliar o sucesso das soluções entregues, identificar áreas de melhoria e garantir a satisfação das partes interessadas;
Comunicação e apresentação de resultados:Comunica-se efetivamente com as partes interessadas em todos os níveis da organização, incluindo a apresentação de resultados, o compartilhamento de atualizações de projetos e a discussão de questões técnicas e de negócios.Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa dominar:Conhecimento sólido em linguagens de programação e frameworks relevantes para o domínio do projeto (por exemplo: Java, .NET, JavaScript, Python, etc.), com experiência em desenvolvimento de aplicativos e soluções em ambientes empresariais;
Experiência em desenvolvimento e design de APIs, incluindo o uso de padrões como REST, SOAP e gRPC;
Domínio em arquitetura de sistemas e design de software, incluindo padrões de design, microserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos;
Experiência com práticas de integração de sistemas, como ESB (Enterprise Service Bus), SOA (Arquitetura Orientada a Serviços) e iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service);
Proficiência em bancos de dados e sistemas de gerenciamento de bancos de dados (SQL e NoSQL), bem como em tecnologias de armazenamento e recuperação de dados;
Conhecimento em práticas de CI/CD (Integração Contínua e Entrega Contínua) e ferramentas associadas, como Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, CircleCI e Travis CI;
Familiaridade com metodologias ágeis de desenvolvimento de software, como Scrum e Kanban, e experiência na aplicação de princípios Lean no gerenciamento de projetos;
Domínio em automação detestes e ferramentas de garantia de qualidade, como Selenium, JUnit, TestNG e outras;
Conhecimento em segurança de aplicações e APIs, incluindo autenticação, autorização, criptografia e conformidade com regulamentações e padrões relevantes;
Experiência em gerenciamento de infraestrutura e serviços em nuvem, como AWS, Azure e Google Cloud Platform;
Capacidade de analisar e solucionar problemas de desempenho e escalabilidade, aplicando técnicas de otimização e monitoramento de aplicativos.O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;

- Industry Knowledge: Foundational understanding of parcel transportation or warehouse operations.

- Communication: Strong ability to present data findings in a clear, concise manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Outstanding follow-through, time management and planning skills to deliver results.
- Able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment as the market develops in unpredictable ways, producing high quality work and projecting a positive attitude.Preferred Skills/Qualifications:
- Experience operating within a Transportation Management System (TMS).
- Prior experience working with major parcel carriers, such as DHL Express, UPS, and FedEx.
- Intermediate to Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel (or Google Workspace), with working knowledge of SQL and Tableau.
- Prior Forecasting experienceLocation: LATAM (Must align with US PST Time Zone)Language Requirement: Advanced EnglishWhy choose us? title: Visual & Brand Experience Designer
description: Visual & Brand Experience DesignerAbout the Role We are seeking an experienced Visual & Brand Experience Designer to support a large-scale digital product initiative focused on modernizing the user experience of a leading marketplace platform. This role will play a key part in reimagining how customers navigate and interact with a multi-brand digital ecosystem.You will lead the Visual Makeover & Usability workstream while also helping shape a multi-brand gallery experience that brings together multiple brands within a single marketplace environment. The ideal candidate is a highly creative product designer who can quickly move from research and benchmarking into compelling visual concepts that inspire stakeholders and guide product direction.This is a fast-paced consulting environment with short delivery cycles, so comfort working in ambiguous environments and presenting bold ideas to senior stakeholders is essential.What You'll Do Design and lead the visual direction for key product workstreams focused on improving usability and modernizing the marketplace interface. Conduct benchmarking of leading global marketplace platforms to inform design strategy and identify best-in-class user experience patterns. Develop high-fidelity visual concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate new interface directions and inspire product leadership. Design and prototype a multi-brand navigation and discovery experience that enables users to seamlessly browse across brands within a unified marketplace. Collaborate closely with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to translate design ideas into clear product directions. Present design concepts and rationale to senior stakeholders, helping guide decision-making around product experience and visual identity. Work within a fast-moving consulting team delivering iterative design outputs across short delivery cycles.Required Qualifications 5+ years of experience in product design, visual design, or UI design Strong portfolio demonstrating high-quality interface design and visual storytelling Deep understanding of e-commerce and marketplace design patterns Experience analyzing and benchmarking international digital products Ability to produce high-fidelity concepts and exploratory prototypes that communicate bold design ideas Comfort presenting conceptual work to senior leadership and stakeholders Fluency in Portuguese (required working language) Ability to thrive in fast-paced consulting environments with rapid iteration cyclesPreferred Qualifications Experience designing multi-brand digital ecosystems or marketplaces Familiarity with Asian marketplace and super-app UX paradigms such as those seen in Alibaba, Shopee, or Pinduoduo Background working with retail, consumer products, or marketplace platforms Previous experience in agency or consulting environments with fast delivery timelinesIf you're a designer who enjoys pushing visual boundaries, exploring global product patterns, and shaping the experience of large-scale digital platforms, this role offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on a high-visibility product initiative.

title: Freight Desk Manager
description: Position Scope TheFreight Desk Manageris a high-impact leadership role responsible for architecting and overseeing the logistics support function for non-finished goods on a global scale, with a dedicated focus on theLATAM region. This position operates at the intersection of global procurement and operational execution, managing a complex ecosystem of freight forwarders, control towers, and internal stakeholders. The mission is to ensure world-class shipment execution and financial integrity through robust audit structures and the expansion of logistics capabilities in high-growth markets. Responsibilities and Accountabilities Regional Strategy & Expansion:Serve as the primary architect for logistics operations in LATAM, including the enablement of Importer of Record (IOR) operations and regional supplier onboarding. Global Freight Desk Leadership:Lead the logistics support function for specialized shipments, managing a network of global freight forwarders operating through dedicated control towers. Rate Card Governance:Standardize and maintain global Bulk Air and Ocean rate cardsacross a diverse portfolio of international suppliers to ensure cost consistency and transparency. Strategic Sourcing:Lead RFQs and supplier onboarding initiativesfor logistics, ensuring all partners meet global compliance and service level standards. Governance & Audit Architecture:Design and maintain a global freight audit strategy and control architecture to ensure financial discipline across high-volume global invoice environments. Control Tower Oversight:Drive operational excellence by governing forwarder performance, ensuring industry-leading on-time shipment execution across all transport modes. Automation & Process Engineering:Implement automated invoice approval systems and systemic controls to improve first-pass yield and overall operational efficiency. Stakeholder Management:Partner with global cross-functional teams to support non-standard logistics requirements and rapid-response delivery programs. Mandatory Requirements Experience:Extensive experience in Global Supply Management, Logistics Procurement, or Supply Chain Operations within multinational environments. Regional Expertise:Deep knowledge of theLATAM logistics landscape, including regulatory requirements, customs, and supplier networks. Procurement Mastery:Proven track record inleading RFQsand managing complexlogistics supplier onboardingprocesses. Network Management:Experience managing large-scale global freight forwarder relationships and\ "Control Tower\" operational models. Technical Proficiency:Strong background in Logistics Financial Control (Freight Audit) and managing high-volume, global-scale invoice environments. Leadership:Experience leading international teams and managing external providers across different time zones (APAC, EMEA, AMR). Education:Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, International Trade, or a related field. Languages:Fluency inEnglishis essential for regional and global coordination. Desirable Requirements Advanced Education:MBA or Master's degree. Process Excellence:Certifications in Lean Six Sigma or similar experience. Digital Transformation:Experience implementing AI-driven or automated financial auditing and rate management tools. Rapid Growth Background:Experience managing logistics for hyper-growth programs (e.G., international express expansions or specialized delivery models).

title: Arquiteto Sênior Sap Basis E Infraestrutura
description: Sobre a EmpresaVocê atuará como referência técnica em projetos estratégicos e ambientes de alta complexidade. Será responsável por impulsionar a evolução técnica do time, fortalecer o framework de conhecimento e certificações, além de apoiar iniciativas críticas e o time de Suporte (MS).Sobre o PapelProcuramos um(a) profissional com visão de arquitetura, mentalidade de aprendizado contínuo e forte interesse em tecnologias emergentes como SAP BTP, IA, SAP Activate e integrações com Azure, AWS e GCP.ResponsabilidadesLiderar iniciativas técnicas SAP Basis, incluindo migrações (S/4HANA, ECC, PI/PO, etc), upgrades e projetos críticos em ambientes Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP). Conduzir assessments técnicos e de performance (tunning, banco de dados, arquitetura, etc) e definir recomendações de otimização. Atuar como referência técnica e ponto de escalonamento, oferecendo suporte Nível 3 e 4, inclusive em situações de crise (war rooms) em ambientes complexos. Desenvolver e manter arquitetura SAP, garantindo escalabilidade, segurança, alta disponibilidade e aderência às melhores práticas da SAP e dos hyperscalers. Apoiar os times de suporte (Managed Services) e Projetos (Professional Services), incluindo manutenção, melhorias, auditorias, mudanças, atualizações e rotinas operacionais em SAP ECC, S/4 e RISE. Colaborar com stakeholders internos/externos, garantindo alinhamento estratégico, qualidade das entregas e orientação técnica ao time Basis. Promover inovação e aprendizagem contínua, pesquisando novas tecnologias (IA, BTP, ALM, accelerators Azure/AWS/GCP) e disseminando conhecimento para o time.QualificaçõesGraduação em Ciência da Computação ou área relacionada. Proficiência avançada em português, e espanhol (intermediário). Experiência Sênior em SAP Basis.Habilidades NecessáriasCertificações: (certificação direta pela SAP): SAP OS/DB Migration, SAP Technology Consultant Expert, SAP HANA 2.0, SAP Certified Application Professional, Certificações SAP Solution Consultant (ex.: BTP, Implementation Consultant, etc.). Liderança técnica e arquitetura SAP: Experiência em gestão de crises, condução de projetos complexos, desenho/arquitetura de soluções e liderança de iniciativas multidisciplinares, incluindo migração e implementação de SAP S/4HANA (Public e Private Cloud) e RISE. Administração e otimização de ambientes SAP: Sólida atuação em upgrades (NetWeaver, Support Packages via SUM), cópias homogêneas e heterogêneas, migração de dados e troubleshooting em ambientes complexos e sob pressão. Base técnica robusta: Conhecimentos avançados em bancos de dados (Oracle, SQL Server, DB2), sistemas operacionais (SUSE) e domínio de administração de sistemas SAP. Ferramentas, idiomas e mindset: Experiência com ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Grafana e Dynatrace, além de forte compromisso com aprendizado contínuo e evolução tecnológica.

title: Senior Full-Stack Mobile Engineer (React Native)
description: This role requires deep, verified React Native experience. If your background is primarily React web, native iOS/Android, or backend-only, this is not the right fit.FlyMeOut is a profitable, invite-only social travel network growing over 160% year-over-year. We run a highly selective social travel platform — and we're moving fast and expanding offerings in 2026.We're not pre-revenue. We're not burning cash. We're growing, and we need a senior full-stack mobile engineer who can ship production React Native features on day one.What you'll build: You'll lead development across our React Native mobile app (Expo, TypeScript, TanStack Query, Zustand) and work with our existing Node.Js/TypeScript backend. The work is technically interesting — complex booking flows across yacht charters and villa rentals, payment orchestration with Stripe and Apple Pay, real-time features, and third-party API integrations. This isn't maintenance. You're shipping features that users interact with immediately.Day to day, you'll be working on things like: Designing and building new features end-to-end in React Native with TypeScript Architecting booking and payment flows across multiple travel verticals Integrating with payment platforms (Stripe, Apple Pay) and partner reservation APIs Working with Firebase for auth, real-time data, and push notifications Collaborating directly with the founder on product direction and technical decisions Code reviews and mentoring a mid-level React Native engineer on the teamYou should have: 5+ years shipping production React Native apps (not React web — we will verify this) Strong experience with Expo, TypeScript, and modern state management (TanStack Query, Zustand, or similar) Backend capability with Node.Js — you can work with and extend our existing API layer Hands-on experience integrating third-party APIs, especially payment processors Comfort working independently in a small team where you own the outcomeNice to have: Experience with travel tech, hospitality, or marketplace platforms Familiarity with booking/reservation systems Experience leading or mentoring other engineers Apple Pay integration experienceWhy FlyMeOut: Profitable company with real revenue — not a cash-burning startup hoping for a runway extension Growing 160%+ year-over-year with a planned fundraise in summer 2026 Fully remote — we hire across Latin America and work on overlapping timezones Lean team, big ownership — your input directly shapes the product Expanding into yacht charters, villa rentals, and restaurant reservations — you'd be building these from the ground up Work directly with the founder on product and technical directionCompensation & Terms This is a full-time remote contractor position paid as a flat monthly rate via Wise. Salary range: $60,000–$84,000/year ($5,000–$7,000/month) Time off: 2 weeks PTO (flexible) Health benefits: Not offered at this stage Equity: Discussed on a case-by-case basis Probation: 2 weeks Core collaboration hours: 7:00 AM–2:00 PM PST | 12:00 PM–7:00 PM BrasilHow to Apply Send your resume towith the subject lineFMO-RN-2026. In the body of your email, name one React Native app you have shipped that is currently live on the App Store or Google Play. Applications without this subject line will not be reviewed.

title: Assistente Administrativo
description:
Você está em uma jornada para ingressar em uma empresa emocionante e fazer parte de nossa história de sucesso. Aqui vamos equipá-lo com o know-how e a experiência que definirão seu crescimento. Nesta função em que você está prestes a embarcar, você deve cumprir as seguintes responsabilidades:Atender às ocorrências operacionais relacionadas a ambientes da empresa, como vazamentos, falhas elétricas, problemas em vestiários, refeitório, banheiros, entre outros. Acionar fornecedores de manutenção corretiva e acompanhar a execução dos serviços contratados. Verificar no local a natureza do problema e registrar a ocorrência de forma adequada. Conferir se os serviços foram realizados conforme combinado, observando prazos, qualidade e emissão da nota fiscal. Utilizar o sistema de gestão de viagens corporativas para registrar, acompanhar e controlar solicitações, aprovações, reservas e prestação de contas. Apoiar o controle das rotinas operacionais de Facilities, em interface com a equipe. Auxiliar no acompanhamento do transporte fretado, consumo no restaurante e funcionamento dos equipamentos e estruturas da unidade. Manter registros atualizados em planilhas e relatórios simples de ocorrências e atendimentos realizados. Apoiar o controle orçamentário da área, acompanhando os gastos mensais com serviços de Facilities e viagens, e comparando com o previsto. Sinalizar ao Supervisor e a equipe, eventuais falhas ou desvios operacionais.Requisitos: Ensino Médio Completo, desejável cursando Ensino Superior em Administração ou áreas correlatas;
Conhecimento em Pacote Office, principalmente Excel e PowerPoint;
Disponibilidade para atuação 100% presencial em Feira de Santana-BA. Desejável conhecimento na execução de atividades operacionais relacionadas aos serviços de Facilities como: viagens, hospedagens, combustíveis, táxi, locações de veículos (Frota), apoio quanto a solicitação dos materiais de limpeza e fardamentos, cadastros de fornecedores internos;
Vivência com o sistema SAP será considerado um diferencial.Aviso Legal: Ao nos enviar seu currículo e dados pessoais, considera-se que você deu seu consentimento para que mantenhamos suas informações em nosso banco de dados de recrutamento de talentos. Todas as informações fornecidas serão usadas exclusivamente para o processo seletivo. A RGE somente coletará, utilizará, processará ou divulgará informações pessoais quando e onde for permitido pelas leis aplicáveis.Somente os candidatos pré-selecionados serão contatados para entrevista. Nos empenhamos em responder a todos os candidatos. No entanto, se você não receber uma resposta nossa em até 60 dias, por favor, considere sua candidatura para esta vaga como não aprovada. Podemos entrar em contato futuramente para oportunidades que correspondam às suas qualificações e experiência.Obrigado por considerar uma carreira na RGE.

title: Product Owner - Sênior
description: Product Owner - Sênior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que unetecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitaispara solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora comoparte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.Empresas comoSmiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgásconfiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantirambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura demulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?Qual será o seu papel? No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.Como será seu dia a dia? Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto. Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto. Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários. Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.Para esta vaga, é essencial: Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio. Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo "mão na massa", orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade. Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia. Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs). Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery. Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.Você pode se destacar se: Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital. Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe). Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional. Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico. Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência. Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade. Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador. Demonstrar orientação a resultados e senso de urgência. Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que unetecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitaispara solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora comoparte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.Empresas comoSmiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgásconfiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.Diversidade e Inclusão Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantirambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura demulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiarvalidações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático dePython para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial comDatabricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

title: Engenheiro De Dados - Júnior
description:
Engenheiro de Dados - Júnior A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.Sobre a Rethink Somos uma consultoria que unetecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitaispara solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura demulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência. Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?Qual será o seu papel? Como Engenheiro de Dados Júnior, seu papel será crucial no apoio à construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados robustos e eficientes, principalmente no ambiente Databricks. Você será responsável por garantir a entrega contínua de dados transformados e governados, desde a ingestão até a disponibilização para consumo analítico. Sua atuação contribuirá diretamente para a qualidade, confiabilidade e acessibilidade dos dados, sendo um membro fundamental na equipe de engenharia de dados.Como será seu dia a dia? Apoiar a construção e sustentação de pipelines de dados no Databricks, utilizando notebooks, jobs e pipelines;
Garantir a entrega contínua das camadas Bronze, Silver e Gold dentro da arquitetura de dados;
Ingerir, transformar e disponibilizar dados para consumo analítico;
Criar e manter tabelas Delta e views para suporte a dashboards e análises;
Atuar com compartilhamento e consumo de dados via Delta Sharing;
Apoiar a governança de dados utilizando Unity Catalog, gerenciando catálogos, schemas e permissões;
Monitorar execuções de pipelines, identificar falhas e realizar troubleshooting;
Corrigir causas-raiz e propor melhorias de confiabilidade e performance;
Implementar e/ou apoiarvalidações de qualidade de dados;
Documentar pipelines, regras de negócio e a linhagem básica dos dados;
Colaborar com analistas, times de BI e áreas de negócio para entendimento de requisitos e evolução das entregas.Para esta vaga, é essencial: Conhecimento sólido de SQL (joins, agregações, CTEs, window functions e modelagem básica para analytics);
Conhecimento prático dePython para dados (manipulação, leitura/escrita e organização de código em notebooks);
Noções de Apache Spark/Databricks (DataFrames, particionamento, leitura/escrita em Delta e execução distribuída em alto nível);
Experiência inicial comDatabricks (uso de notebooks, jobs, clusters e boas práticas básicas);
Familiaridade com pipelines de dados e arquitetura Medallion (Bronze/Silver/Gold), mesmo em contexto acadêmico ou projetos;
Conhecimento em Git e controle de versão (branch, PR e resolução simples de conflitos);
Capacidade de investigar problemas (logs, métricas simples, reprocessamentos) e comunicar status com clareza;
Disponibilidade para atuar com sustentação de rotinas, acompanhando falhas e correções dentro do horário acordado.Você pode se destacar se: Tiver experiência com Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, integrações, parâmetros, monitoramento). Possuir conhecimento prático de Unity Catalog (permissões, data access, boas práticas de governança). Tiver vivência com Delta Sharing (publicação/consumo e cuidados com segurança e contratos de dados). Possuir experiência com orquestração e automação (Databricks Workflows, CI/CD, Databricks Repos, Azure DevOps/GitHub Actions). Tiver conhecimento em Data Quality e Observabilidade (ex.: Great Expectations/Deequ, métricas, SLIs/SLOs, alertas). Possuir experiência em otimização no Databricks/Delta (partitioning, Z-ORDER, OPTIMIZE/VACUUM, caching, controle de custos). Tiver noções de modelagem dimensional e consumo por ferramentas de BI (camadas semânticas, performance para dashboards). Possuir conhecimento de segurança e boas práticas (RBAC, segregação de ambientes, secrets, princípios de menor privilégio).Curtiu a oportunidade? Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente!

Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and leading AI-native transformation at scale.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti's broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
- Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
- Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
- Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
- Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
- Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
- Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team's scope.
- Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
- Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
- Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).
- Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
- Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
- Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.
- Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
- Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
- Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
- Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
- Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
- Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.
- Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
- Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
- An open organisation. Titles don't define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone's work is seen and valued.Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

title: Software Engineering Manager
description:
ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world's largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.Syniti's Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti's award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.Syniti's cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.THE ROLE The Manager I of Engineering plays a key leadership role, directly managing a small team of software engineers. This role is responsible for ensuring timely delivery of high-quality software projects, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture, and supporting the professional growth of engineers. In addition to leading day-to-day execution, this manager contributes to tactical decision-making, participates in architectural discussions, and ensures engineering efforts are aligned with project goals. They collaborate closely with product, design, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver solutions that support Syniti's broader mission.WHAT YOU WILL DO
- Manage and support a team of software engineers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.
- Provide coaching, mentorship, and regular performance feedback to support individual growth.
- Guide the team in applying engineering best practices, including code reviews, testing, and secure development.
- Participate in architectural and technical design discussions, ensuring sound engineering decisions.
- Collaborate closely with product and cross-functional teams to align priorities and deliver value.
- Help shape a positive and inclusive team culture that fosters engagement, learning, and innovation.
- Identify and address delivery risks, blockers, or process gaps within the team's scope.
- Contribute to hiring and onboarding of new engineers, and support team scaling efforts.WHAT IT TAKES
- Proven experience as a team lead or first-line engineering manager in a software development environment.
- Strong technical foundation in modern software development (e.G., C#, Go, React, TypeScript, AWS).
- Familiarity with agile development methodologies, DevOps practices, and software delivery processes.
- Excellent communication and collaboration skills across technical and non-technical stakeholders.
- Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and support the growth of engineering team members.
- Experience participating in technical design, architecture reviews, and secure development practices.
- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, distributed, and cross-functional environment.Be fully aligned to our core values:
- Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don't know they have.
- Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
- Take Action - Be the first. Don't wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
- Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.WHAT WE OFFER
- Trust in your talent. At Syniti you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our style.
- Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
- Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won't stand alone.
- Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating with each depicting a different journey and we want to hear them all.
- Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
- An open organisation. Titles don't define access at Syniti. We stay humble regardless of where we sit in the organisation. We want to hear every voice, listen to all the ideas and make sure everyone's work is seen and valued.Our Commitment to Inclusion At Syniti, we're committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team. We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we're dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we're here to support you.

tools and applying them in development workflowsBuilding AI-Powered Features Experience integrating LLM APIs into applications Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems Familiarity with concepts such as RAG, semantic search or vector databases Ability to evaluate AI outputs and design reliable user-facing features Awareness of data privacy and security considerations when title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter towith subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter towith subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026
